mechanics.name: Five Moves Ahead
mechanics.currentEffect: While you are inside the Killer's Terror Radius or being chased by the Killer, you see the Auras of the 5 closest Pallets. After you drop a Pallet, you start moving 50% earlier. Dropping a Pallet puts the perk on a 40/35/30-second cooldown.
activation: Be inside the Killer's Terror Radius or be chased by the Killer to see the 5 closest Pallets and receive the Pallet-drop movement benefit.
Ends/deactivates when: The Aura and movement effects are unavailable while the perk is on its 40/35/30-second cooldown.
Ends/deactivates when: Outside the Killer's Terror Radius and chase, the active effects are unavailable.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.2.0): Specialized the perk to Pallets only and clarified the Pallet-drop benefit as starting movement 50% earlier; cooldown remains 40/35/30 seconds.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: In danger, see the five nearest Pallets; dropping one lets you resume movement earlier and then starts a tiered cooldown.
specialInteractions: The Aura effect now tracks only Pallets, not Windows.
The 50% value means you start moving earlier after the Pallet drop; it is not a generic 50% Pallet-drop interaction-speed bonus.

editorial.summary: During chase or Terror Radius pressure, see the five closest Pallets and begin moving 50% earlier after dropping one, with a cooldown after each drop.
useCases: Route toward remaining resources once a chase starts.
Make pallet drops safer against ranged and zoning Killers.
Create extra distance after a stun or forced pallet break.
counters: Dropping a pallet starts a 40/35/30-second cooldown.
The aura information is unavailable outside chase and the Killer's Terror Radius.
Killers such as The Nurse can reduce the value of pallet-focused routing.
pros: Combines chase information with a real pallet-interaction advantage.
Particularly strong for experienced players who already know window locations.
Useful against a very wide range of Killers.
cons: Less beginner-friendly than current Windows of Opportunity.
Cooldown can remove the information immediately after a pallet is used.
analysis: Five Moves Ahead became the dedicated Pallet counterpart to the reworked Windows of Opportunity. It now shows only the five closest Pallets, but still provides the powerful 50% earlier movement after a Pallet drop.

That earlier movement can materially change whether the Killer catches you during the post-drop recovery window, especially against ranged or anti-loop powers where every fraction of a second matters.
Losing Window information narrows the perk considerably. It is excellent at answering the question “where is my next Pallet?” and no longer tries to solve the whole tile for you.
The result is a strong chase specialist rather than broad map information. Its old placement needs review because the 10.2 version has a clearer job and a smaller information footprint.
editorial.verdict: A focused Pallet-routing and Pallet-recovery perk after 10.2. Stronger at its specific job, narrower as an all-purpose chase map.
